# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Sequence Preservation And Empirical-Lane Packet Direction

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-09-01`

Direction ID: `SCI-FRUIT-DIR-PRESERVE-SEQUENCE-AND-PREPARE-EL-PACKET-2026-09-01`

Status: **owner direction recorded; prepare an authorization packet only; no
empirical-lane gate is approved by this record**

## Direction

After review of the conflict between the requested Stage B launch and the
accepted SCI-FRUIT claim-layer sequence, the scientific owner directed that
the accepted sequence be preserved. After the accepted Stage A commit was
pushed, the owner directed preparation of the empirical-lane authorization
packet.

The preserved sequence is:

```text
accepted candidate-neutral framework
  -> separately authorized quarantined method development
  -> frozen held-out qualification
  -> scientific-owner-approved qualified-method record
  -> sealed implementation-blind author packet
  -> method-specific Stage B
```

## Effect

This direction resolves the earlier sequencing ambiguity in favor of the
accepted empirical-development and qualification path. It authorizes creation,
review, exact-byte binding, and verification of a successor Stage A owner-
review packet.

Because exact control, population, profile, protocol, candidate-family, and
execution bindings are not yet available, the packet must not disguise a broad
lane launch as a process decision. It must expose the missing bindings and
return separately gated authorization decisions.

## Non-Effect

This direction does not itself approve Gate 0, launch method development,
inspect additional implementation, modify code, identify or open a development
or qualification population, run a reduction or benchmark, select a profile,
metric, threshold, recurrence, parent route, adaptation or stopping policy, or
authorize Unity work. It does not create a qualified-method record or dispatch
Stage B.
